description: Undo: the version the current version was made from (undo in builder_changes) is saved again as a new version and becomes current. Nothing is deleted: the undone version stays in the history and can be restored the same way. No AI, no credits; the preview is copied or rebuilt in about a minute. Not while an AI step of the app runs. Tell the person which version comes back, ask, and pass confirm: true. Developer role. Every plan with an account.

version.description: Version id to bring back (optional, default the undo target from builder_changes)

name: undo_builder_change
title: Undo the last app builder change
